facts.identity: Exact legal entity and 50,034 square metre property link the issuer land acquisition and title disclosures to the government-published September 18 planning drawing. The notice names 内蒙古皓扬云启数据科技有限公司绿色算力数据中心项目 in 敕勒川乳业开发区, Tumed Left Banner, Hohhot.
facts.land_acquisition: February 24, 2025 issuer filing says the subsidiary successfully bid on February 23 and received the Hohhot Public Resources Trading Center transaction confirmation on February 24, for 50,034 square metres of industrial land with a 50-year term at RMB13,208,976. No numeric parcel identifier or map was found in the four-page filing.
facts.land_title: March 11, 2025 issuer filing reports the Tumed Left Banner Natural Resources Bureau executed the land-use-right transfer contract and issued the property title on March 11. The two-page filing does not provide a readable certificate identifier, parcel locator or coordinate.
facts.land_use_planning_context: The March 13, 2025 Hohhot Natural Resources Bureau report explicitly names this green data center and reports March 11 delivery of the property title, land-use-right transfer contract and construction-land planning permit (建设用地规划许可证). This is historical land-use planning context; it does not establish a DC building-work permit or achieved works.
facts.planning_notice: The September 18, 2026 official banner notice is signed by 呼和浩特敕勒川乳业开发区政务服务局, identifies a new-build project and invites objections from adjacent property owners/interested parties before September 24. Its location, heights and dimensions are referred to the attached general layout plan. This public consultation is not treated as an issued building permit.
facts.plan_identity: The government notice directly embeds the captured plan. The economic table gives total land area 50034.00 square metres, matching the issuer property. The drawing title names the same project/company, and the sheet is dated 2026.09.
facts.geometry: The exact property plan is now captured, but no defensible numeric WGS84 point was established. Small boundary/grid annotations in the 1810 by 1280 JPEG are too faint to transcribe reliably. No coordinate-zone/central-meridian identification or independently georeferenced road controls were established.
facts.status: The previously captured September 30 issuer announcement can support announced status if geometry is resolved. Future delivery dates, land title, planning consultation, and the ancillary substation pre-approval EIA are not evidence of achieved data-center construction.
